svg.title: Open proposals: two channels can refuse one, a third can only object, and every outcome is kept
svg.desc: Five numbered steps. One: the model writes an open proposal, a hypothesis, an action, a size and a forecast. Two: code reviews it on three channels; facts and feasibility can refuse it, the strategy channel can only object. Three: every outcome is kept in the method record, published, published over an objection, refused or unpublished. Four: the record is read on two separate axes, payoff after assumed costs and whether the stated probability was right. Five: a comparison of three arms is frozen before it starts and run forward from the same capital, with missing marks left as holes. Nothing is promoted and no order is placed.

text.tspan: A different strategy can still be a valid proposal.
Code checks facts and authority. The model owns the hypothesis.
02 · CODE REVIEWS IT ON THREE CHANNELS
Two can refuse it. One can only object.
Refused and unpublished proposals still count
Each record freezes the method text, forecast, inputs and review. Revisions append; nothing is rewritten.
Payoff and being right, scored apart
A call can be right and still lose money. Schematic.
A comparison frozen before it starts
Same capital, same costs. A missing mark stays a hole.
Evidence for human review: no automatic method promotion, sizing or order placement.
